data.long_meaning: One who searches for knowledge and wisdom. The name Kuhaal carries the meaning “The Seeker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuhaal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
